Part 1 - Classes and Methods / ODMenuBar

DisableAll

Mac OS

The DisableAll method disables all menus in this menu bar, except for system menus (for example, the Apple menu and the Guide menu).

void DisableAll ();
SEE ALSO
The ODMenuBar::EnableAll method (page 401).
"Enabling Menus and Commands" on page 244 in OpenDoc Programmer's Guide.
